transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Permission requests from hooks use presentation native-tui.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: Question outcomes this pipeline passes include answered, failed, cancelled, and superseded. claudeQuestionOutcome itself returns answered or cancelled from a cancelled flag.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: Permission outcomes the builders accept are allowed, denied, dismissed, and unknown. OTLP tool_decision maps reject plus source user_abort to dismissed, and other rejects to denied.

applicability.notes: ROW FIELD field.wait.question. PENDING DOWNSTREAM MAPPING into MonitorAgentRow. This is one of 74 canonical row fields. It is not an SDK contract leaf. Schema acceptance is not complete provenance. verification.status source-read is a static reading. observation.presence unknown means no live sample was taken. It does not mean the row value is missing. classification.adapterEmittable and uiReachable stay unknown. A raw adapter property is not the row field, and a catalog consumer is not a proven UI path.   field.wait.tool can be fed by the permission tool string.
